name: belgium-einvoice
description: Belgian structured e-invoicing for 2026: the B2B obligation in force since 1 January 2026 under VAT Code art. 53 § 2bis (Law of 6 February 2024, amended by the Law of 10 February 2026), the Royal Decree of 8 July 2025 (Peppol BIS in UBL over the Peppol network, rounding, fines), who must send and who must be able to receive, exclusions (art. 44 exempt businesses, flat-rate farmers, businesses not established in Belgium), self-billing, credit notes, the EUR 1,500 / 3,000 / 5,000 fines, the three-month tolerance in early 2026 and the self-billing tolerance to 30 June 2026, B2G invoicing through Mercurius, Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 fields and validation, VAT computed per VAT category, archiving for seven years, and the 120% cost deduction for small businesses. Trigger on: Peppol Belgium, e-invoicing Belgium 2026, e-facturatie, facturation électronique, structured invoice Belgium, Mercurius, Peppol BIS, UBL Belgium, B2B e-invoice fine. Out of scope: VAT rates and returns (be-vat-return), book
